subject: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com>; Priya Sharma <priya@horizonlytics.com>
Cc: HorizonLytics Security Team <security@horizonlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist

Alex / Priya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and recommended next steps so we can get the pilot moving: 

1) Primary pain & goal (what we heard)
- Pain: high latency and inconsistent hallucination rate on downstream question-answering over indexed docs (search+QA).
- Goal: reduce tail latency to <250ms for 95th percentile and lower hallucination rate on product-spec queries by 30% vs current baseline.

2) Proposed pilot scope (Redwood-managed hosted runtime + private VPC connector for data)
- Dataset: ~120k product docs (S3 - read-only).
- Model variant: open-Llama-70B q4_0 + Redwood recommended caching profile and KV-preserve config.
- Workloads: 4k daily queries, peak burst to 60 qps for short windows.
- Success metrics: latency P95 <250ms, answer precision (prompt eval set) +30% over baseline, cost target <$0.003/token averaged.

3) Evaluation plan and prompts
- Attached: horizon_pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv — 120 prompts (mix: intent detection, spec QA, long-context summarization).
- We will run blind A/B runs vs your current endpoint for a sample week and surface per-prompt regressions in our eval dashboard.

4) Owners & timelines
- HorizonLytics owners: Alex (technical lead), Priya (data owner/security contact).
- Redwood owners: Soojin (engagement lead), Ben Carter (platform engineer), Karthik Iyer (solutions/ops).
- Proposed kickoff (internal): provision test env by 2026-10-27; run eval & tuning 10/28–11/10; decision checkpoint 11/12.

5) Access & pre-reqs (what we need from you)
- S3 read role or presigned sample export (see redwood_access_checklist.pdf).
- A short list of 10 high-value queries + expected answers for goldset.
- Security questionnaire from your team — if privacy constraints require VPC-only, we’ll schedule a private deployment scoping call.

6) Risks / open items
- If dataset contains many long PDFs, we may need extra preprocessing — call this out upfront.
- If you need an on-prem model, cost & timeline will change; we can quote.

Next steps: please confirm owners/times and grant the sample S3 access or a small export by EOD 10/26 so we can stand up test infra on 10/27.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: horizon_pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (csv), redwood_access_checklist.pdf (pdf), mvp_success_metrics.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@horizonlytics.com>, HorizonLytics Security Team <security@horizonlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist

Thanks, Soojin — helpful summary. Confirming a few items and adding clarifications from our side: 

- Owners: confirmed — I’ll be technical lead, Priya will shepherd security/data gating. I’ll loop our infra contact if we need cross-account roles.
- Timeline: 10/27 for test infra looks good; we can target the 11/12 checkpoint.
- Data: we can produce a 10k-document sample export by 10/25; full 120k export will take longer (planning for 11/1). Please proceed with staging on the sample.
- Prompts: I reviewed the prompt set — two asks: please add a dedicated prompt for "spec-compliance" (we want exact match for policy terms) and flag any prompts that exceed 2,000 tokens.

Security note (from Priya in-thread): we prefer to avoid cross-account IAM roles until our security review completes. We will share a presigned S3 export and a short IP allowlist for the Redwood test fleet. HorizonLytics Security Team will send a brief questionnaire by tomorrow.

We are comfortable starting with the hosted test plan as long as presigned export + IP allowlist is accepted. Final question: can Redwood surface per-prompt hallucination rates in the dashboard (we need it for legal review)?

—Alex
Alex Chen | Director of ML Ops, HorizonLytics
alex.chen@horizonlytics.com | (212) 555-0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@horizonlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist

Forwarding the HorizonLytics confirmation. Key changes from original plan: they will provide a 10k presigned export first (no cross-account role) and need per-prompt hallucination metrics surfaced. Priya's security team will send questionnaire — expect to coordinate.

Action items for us before 10/27 provision: 
- Ben: provision hosted test env with IP allowlist option + ensure we can ingest presigned export flow.
- Karthik: add per-prompt hallucination metric to eval dashboard and expose export CSV for legal (columns: prompt_id, n_tokens, hallucination_flag, confidence_score).
- Soojin: update pilot charter doc with revised data delivery timeline and send updated prompt set request to Alex (include spec-compliance prompt).

Attaching: redwood_access_checklist.pdf (internal copy for the runbook).

On Thu, Oct 21, 2026 at 09:04 AM Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Soojin — helpful summary. Confirming a few items and adding clarifications from our side: 
> ...

Thanks team — low-friction pilot, priority is to get the sample in and the dashboard ready for per-prompt metrics.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist

Soojin — I can stand up the hosted test environment with IP allowlist and presigned-s3 ingestion. ETA: 10/27 EOD for baseline infra + basic telemetry. Notes:
- Will default to q4_0 quantized variant and enable prefix KV caching per your note.
- I’ll provision a temporary API key for HorizonLytics tied to the IP allowlist; we’ll rotate keys after the security review.
- I’ll upload an infra stub to the shared Drive link so Alex can validate endpoints once sample is uploaded.

Karthik — please confirm the dashboard export schema you want so I can wire telemetry events to the CSV fields.

Ben
Ben Carter | Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonlytics.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@horizonlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope confirmation — deployment constraints, prompt evals, and access checklist — kickoff plan

Alex / Priya — quick status update now that infra is provisioned for the sample export:

- Infra: hosted test env is provisioned behind IP allowlist. Temporary API key and endpoint details uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4_pilot-charter (Ben shared the stub).
- Prompts: please send the 10 high-value queries + the spec-compliance example; I added a token-length check to the prompt intake and flagged anything >2,000 tokens.
- Eval dashboard: Karthik has added per-prompt hallucination flag and will push a CSV export (prompt_id, query, n_tokens, hallucination_flag, confidence_score) by EOD today.

Next steps we will take this week: ingest sample presigned export, run initial eval sweep, triage any regressions, and propose tuning (quantization vs model variant) by 11/03. Decision checkpoint remains 11/12.

If this looks good, I’ll schedule a 30min kickoff call for 10/28 to sync infra handoff and data transfer owners (invite to follow).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Soojin
summary: Post-call discovery -> pilot kickoff coordination. HorizonLytics will provide a 10k presigned export; Redwood to provision hosted test env with IP allowlist. Owners: Alex (HorizonLytics), Priya (security), Soojin/Ben/Karthik (Redwood). Success metrics and per-prompt hallucination exports confirmed; kickoff call proposed for 10/28.
